manifest.segmentName: ECA/ TeleCheck Data Segment Format Â®
manifest.filterMethod: source_rule_id joins a deep-extraction business rule related to ENT-SEG-113 or one of its direct field entities

requirements.statement: A merchant authorization and check writer copy must be printed for each approved ECA/TeleCheck transaction.
requirements.expected_behavior: Print merchant and check writer copies of authorization
requirements.constraint_text: Print merchant and check writer copies of authorization

requirements.statement: Check writer must sign merchant's copy before transaction is considered complete.
Merchant Name, City/State/ZIP, Merchant Phone, ECA/TeleCheck Service Phone must appear on each receipt copy.
requirements.expected_behavior: Fields must be present on each copy
requirements.constraint_text: Fields must be present on each copy

requirements.statement: Terminal ID, ECA/TeleCheck Merchant ID, Date/Time, Transaction Number, Trace ID, Approval Number required on receipt.
requirements.expected_behavior: Fields must be present on each copy
requirements.constraint_text: Fields must be present on each copy

requirements.statement: Additional recommended fields include Customer Telephone Number if prompted, Custom Field prompt/data, Merchant Trace ID.
requirements.expected_behavior: May include these fields on receipt
requirements.constraint_text: May include these fields on receipt

requirements.statement: Denial Record Receipt prints details and Denial Record Number for consumer on transaction decline.
requirements.expected_behavior: Print Denial Record Number and details
requirements.constraint_text: Print Denial Record Number and details

requirements.statement: Denial Record number is used with all TeleCheck products.
requirements.expected_behavior: Denial Record number used across all TeleCheck products
requirements.constraint_text: Denial Record number used across all TeleCheck products

requirements.statement: Version 2 Denial Receipt must print Denial Record Number, Check Amount, NACHA Language, TeleCheck Phone Number if cashiers not using courtesy cards.
requirements.expected_behavior: Must print Denial Record Number, Check Amount, NACHA Language, TeleCheck Phone Number
requirements.constraint_text: Must print Denial Record Number, Check Amount, NACHA Language, TeleCheck Phone Number

requirements.statement: Data Section No. 3 contains none, one, or more of Check, Variable Information, or ECA/TeleCheck Data Segments.
requirements.expected_behavior: Segments 110, 111, 113 may appear zero or more times.
requirements.constraint_text: Segments 110, 111, 113 may appear zero or more times.

requirements.statement: ECA/TeleCheck Service Transaction Request contains segments in Field Nos. 4-6: Segments 110, 111, 113.
Segment Type field has fixed value 100 for Standard Message Data Segment.
Segment Length includes Segment Type's length and Field Separators.
requirements.expected_behavior: Segment Length value must account for Segment Type and Field Separators
requirements.constraint_text: Segment Length value must account for Segment Type and Field Separators

requirements.statement: Segment Type field has fixed value 101 identifying the Fleet Data Segment.
A Field Separator always follows Segment Type and Segment Length; Field Separator follows Product Amount when it's the last element.
Segment Length should be 4 for EBT with eWIC data transactions.
Segment Type field has a fixed value of 105 in Totals Data Segment.
Element number 239 is used for Alternate MICR Indicator since element 131 is currently in use.
requirements.expected_behavior: Use element number 239 for Alternate MICR Indicator
requirements.constraint_text: Use element number 239 for Alternate MICR Indicator

requirements.statement: A Field Separator exists between Field Nos. 1 and 2 and between Field No. 2 and Variable Information Section.
requirements.expected_behavior: Field Separators placed between Fields 1-2 and 2-Variable Info Section
requirements.constraint_text: Field Separators placed between Fields 1-2 and 2-Variable Info Section

requirements.statement: Segment Type (Field No. 1) has fixed value 111 identifying the Variable Information Data Segment.
Segment Type field has fixed value 112 for Additional Information Data Segment.
ECA/TeleCheck Trace ID must be present in all Void transaction requests.
requirements.expected_behavior: ECA/TeleCheck Trace ID must be present
requirements.constraint_text: ECA/TeleCheck Trace ID must be present

requirements.statement: ECA/TeleCheck Data Segment has a maximum length of 156 alphanumeric characters.
All fields in the segment are separated by Field Separators; unpopulated fields still send the Field Separator.
requirements.expected_behavior: Send Field Separator even if field empty
requirements.constraint_text: Send Field Separator even if field empty

requirements.statement: Extended MICR Data is conditional, used when MICR length is greater than 50-bytes.
requirements.expected_behavior: Extended MICR Data field is present
requirements.constraint_text: Extended MICR Data field is present

requirements.statement: There is a Field Separator between Field Nos. 1 and 2 and between Field Nos. 2 and 3.
requirements.expected_behavior: Field Separators required between fields 1-2 and 2-3
requirements.constraint_text: Field Separators required between fields 1-2 and 2-3

requirements.statement: Segment Type fixed value is 118 for the Proprietary Data Load Segment.
Fuel Volume Data field length is determined by segment length in field 2, up to max 3,600.
requirements.expected_behavior: Field length determined by segment length field
requirements.constraint_text: Field length determined by segment length field

requirements.statement: Segment Type fixed value is 119.
A Field Separator exists between Field Nos. 1 and 2 and between Field Nos. 2 and 3.
requirements.expected_behavior: Field Separator required between these fields
requirements.constraint_text: Field Separator required between these fields

requirements.statement: Segment Type field has fixed value 131 for the EMV Response Data Segment.
Segment Type field fixed value is 134.
Field Nos 1&2 and 2&3 are separated by Field Separators; segment should end with a field separator.
requirements.expected_behavior: Fields separated by Field Separators except within Field 3 data.
requirements.constraint_text: Fields separated by Field Separators except within Field 3 data.

requirements.statement: Segment Type field (Element 85) has fixed value 135 for Moneris Data Segment (Request).
Segment Type field must have fixed value 139 for Moneris Day End Batch Balance Request Segment.
Segment Type field 1 must have fixed value 140.
Segment Type fixed value is 141 for Moneris Day End Batch Close Request segment.
A Field Separator always follows Segment Type and Segment Length, and the last Tax Amount per product.
requirements.expected_behavior: Field Separator placement after Segment Type, Segment Length, and last Tax Amount
requirements.constraint_text: Field Separator placement after Segment Type, Segment Length, and last Tax Amount

requirements.statement: Segment Type field has fixed value 146 for Enhanced Fleet Response Segment.
Fields 1-2, 2-3, and 3-4 are separated by Field Separators; segment ends with a field separator.
requirements.expected_behavior: Fields must be separated by Field Separators except within field 4
requirements.constraint_text: Fields must be separated by Field Separators except within field 4

requirements.statement: Segment Type field has fixed value 149 for Fuel Price Update Request Segment.
Segment Type field 1 has fixed value 150 for Fuel Price Update Response Segment.
Segment Length includes Segment Type's length and Field Separators.
requirements.expected_behavior: Segment Length counts Segment Type length plus Field Separators
requirements.constraint_text: Segment Length counts Segment Type length plus Field Separators

requirements.statement: A Field Separator always follows Segment Type and Segment Length; sent even when field not populated.
requirements.expected_behavior: Field Separator required after Segment Type/Length even if empty
requirements.constraint_text: Field Separator required after Segment Type/Length even if empty

requirements.statement: Segment Length Indicator excludes the Data Type Indicator from its length calculation.
requirements.expected_behavior: Segment length excludes Data Type Indicator
requirements.constraint_text: Segment length excludes Data Type Indicator

requirements.statement: For ECA/TeleCheck processing, refer to Data Element No. 131, ECA/TeleCheck Clerk ID, instead of Clerk ID.
Segment Length has four digits only for segments 103, 114, 115, 118, 120, 130, and 131.
requirements.condition_trigger: Segment is one of EBT, SKU, Print Data, Proprietary Data Load, Print Data 2, EMV Request, EMV Response
requirements.expected_behavior: Segment Length field must be four digits
requirements.constraint_text: Segment Length field must be four digits

requirements.statement: Segment Length cannot have a length of 4 digits when sending any segment other than the listed seven.
requirements.condition_trigger: Segment is not one of the seven listed segments
requirements.expected_behavior: Segment Length must not be 4 digits
requirements.constraint_text: Segment Length must not be 4 digits

requirements.statement: Segment Length is calculated using lengths of all data elements plus Field Separators/Product Data Field Delimiters in the segment.
requirements.expected_behavior: Segment Length equals sum of element lengths and delimiters
requirements.constraint_text: Segment Length equals sum of element lengths and delimiters

requirements.statement: ECA/TeleCheck Data Segment length is 001-156.
Segment Type is required for the TransArmor PKI Encryption and Tokenization Load Request.
requirements.condition_trigger: TransArmor PKI Encryption and Tokenization Load Request

requirements.statement: Segment Type value 106 and 107 are reserved for proprietary use.
When Additional Information Indicator = 005, ECA/TeleCheck Trace ID information is included.
When Additional Information Indicator = 006, ECA/TeleCheck Denial Record Number information is included.
If MICR data > 50 bytes and prompt code is ECA/TeleCheck check service, refer to ECA/TeleCheck Data Segment (Segment 113).
requirements.condition_trigger: MICR data > 50 bytes AND Prompt Code = ECA/TeleCheck check service

requirements.statement: ECA/ TeleCheck Clerk ID valid values range from 1 to 999999.
Extended MICR Data must be populated in addition to MICR Data when raw MICR data exceeds the length.
requirements.condition_trigger: Raw MICR data exceeds MICR Data field length
requirements.expected_behavior: Extended MICR Data (Element 137) must also be populated
requirements.constraint_text: Extended MICR Data (Element 137) must also be populated

requirements.statement: Segment Length value (078) identifies the length in bytes of the Standard Message Data Segment, including field separators.
requirements.expected_behavior: Segment Length must equal actual segment byte length including separators
requirements.constraint_text: Segment Length must equal actual segment byte length including separators

requirements.statement: Segment Length field identifies the length (017 bytes) of the Variable Information Data Segment, including Field Separators.
ECA/TeleCheck Trace ID Table ID is fixed value 005, with fixed table length and maximum length 22.
ECA/TeleCheck Denial Record Number Table ID is fixed value 006, with fixed table length and maximum length 7.
